sources.title: laya-multilingual: 100+ Languages, mmBERT-base 322M, Benchmarks & Limits
sources.snippet: Laya's multilingual checkpoint on Hugging Face: mmBERT-base, 322M parameters, 1024-token context, 100+ languages, faster than the English model, plus calibration and known limits.

sources.title: Laya — 33ms Multilingual System 1 Decision Engine
sources.snippet: I Built Non-Autoregressive Decision Models with RL a Year Ago. Then a Frontier Lab Called It a "Breakthrough". From our March 2025 arXiv paper on sequence conversion trajectories to Laya: a sub-35ms open-weight System 1 decision engine with RLCD, multilingual routing across 100+ languages, and state-of-the-art calibration.

sources.title: Laya AI: Open-Source Decision Model | Run Locally
sources.snippet: Laya AI is an open-source System 1 decision model for typed choices, scores, and probabilities. Run it locally, compare benchmarks, models, and Laya vs Jev.

sources.title: Laya: a decision model that speaks a hundred languages - tokenstead.ai
sources.snippet: Laya is an open decision model: 421M params, 100+ languages, 33ms answers, Apache 2.0 weights. The claims, the caveats, and the context trade against Jev.
